description: This file defines authentication-related routes using Express router, including user registration, login, and retrieving current user information.

methods.name: POST /api/auth/register
methods.description: Registers a new user, generates a JWT token, and returns user info.

methods.name: POST /api/auth/login
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials, generates a JWT token, and returns user info.

methods.name: GET /api/auth/me
methods.description: Returns current authenticated user information, requires authentication.
